notes.title: New Demo Update Out Now - All Aboard the Clawville Express!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/bf4c98915813de24c7e59e9afbbaf19d7f6ed807.png[/img]

[h3]Welcome back, detectives. [/h3]
[i]Step aboard the Clawville Express again, as we have new suspects for you to investigate and other interesting things to explore![/i]

Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville demo has now been updated to a new extended demo, which you can play right now. Come aboard the Clawville Express and explore the mystery with additional story scenes and several improvements. Piece things together using your wits, sharp senses, or even a bit of banter. After all, you’re the slyest detectives in the Wilderness.

[h3]Watch the new extended demo trailer here! [/h3]
[previewyoutube=ATdA5u5I12k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Here’s what’s new in the Extended Demo:[/h3]

[h3]Who killed the ambassador? [/h3]
Additional story scenes that build up the murder incident and connect to the full game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/9c515e8b0a5b4ed1ab2662130c823fb27251f77a.png[/img]

[h3]New faces bring new suspects to investigate.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/b26a94071825cf5c8156bdfd25951f18afcfcc43.png[/img]

[h3]Smoother navigation through the Clawville Express.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/662ae713e8be10abb100b560307b5f9fcf873e36.png[/img]

[h3]Remember not to get too comfy, detectives. You’re here to solve the case![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/413bf4ef771b718be1a9faeafa3cc8c87a6cf90c.png[/img]

[h3]Also, fully voiced cutscenes have been added to deepen the storytelling![/h3]

Thank you for all your support. It’s been a while, and it’s amazing to see the Wilderness community continue to grow. It motivates us to put even more effort into the game. In the meantime, don’t forget to follow us on social media for the latest updates.

Stay tuned, and look forward to the next announcement! 

[h3][b]Wishlist the game, and play the extended demo now![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230450/Moses__Plato__Last_Train_to_Clawville/

[i][b]Be mindful of the passengers, 
and always stay on your paws.

The Wilderness Society. [/b][/i]

[h3][b]Don't forget the news, or join the community![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Uncover the Mystery in Your Favorite Language. New Languages Added to the Demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/bdf62731dc024734655ace82455ce817ff904311.gif[/img]

[h3]Welcome aboard, detectives.[/h3]
[b]We have update the demo with more language options, play now and uncover the mystery on the train! [/b]

We are working hard behind the scenes to bring you the best Wilderness Universe experience. As we get closer to the end of the year, we bring you a major language update that also will be available later in the full game. For now, you can play the demo with 10 different languages available. 

[h3]Here are the list of new languages added to the demo:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hungarian (Magyar) 
[*] Simplified Chinese (简体中文)
[*] Portuguese (Portuguese Brasileiro)
[*] Spanish (Español) 
[*] Korean (한국어)
[*] Russian (русский язык) 
[*] French (Français)
[*] Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)
[*] German (Deutsch)
[*] Japanese (日本語)
[/list]
If there are any bugs or typos in the demo, please send us a feedback on our community Discord. We are eager to hear more inputs from everyone who trying out the demo. Please do enjoy playing as Moses and Plato at the beginning of the story, where you will be introduced with major characters with their distinct banters. 

[h3][b]Play the demo now![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230450/Moses__Plato__Last_Train_to_Clawville/
